fits.reasoning: Pension analytics, global actuarial coordination and M&A due diligence are finance-relevant, but the role is benefits/actuarial consulting rather than core treasury, markets or deal execution.
Direct institutional coverage work across DCM, repo, FX, derivatives hedging and trade finance provides genuine markets and deal-finance exposure at analyst level.
The work is directly aligned with capital raising and M&A execution, but an internship is materially below the user's current experience level.
Hands-on ALM, liquidity and interest-rate risk advisory closely matches the target direction in treasury and financial risk despite the junior title.
Loan pricing and institutional-client analysis are relevant, but the role is primarily relationship-management support and cross-selling rather than direct markets or transaction execution.
The role is centered on valuation analysis and modelling for real assets, which is genuine target valuation work even though it is property-specific.
Substantive financial-risk validation and model governance are relevant, but the work is more control and validation focused than market-risk or hedging execution.
The role has real treasury transaction exposure in repo, FX and collateral, but its day-to-day emphasis is mid-office, payments and operational control.
This is a graduate private-client advisory and relationship role with broad personal-finance content, not analytical treasury, markets, investment decision-making or transaction work.
Complex corporate-finance data analysis is relevant, but the role primarily serves official statistics and reporting rather than investment, treasury or transaction decisions.
Commercial planning, forecasting and profitability analysis are solid FP&A work, but generic business partnering is secondary to the user's treasury, markets and deal priorities.
Investment cases and strategic financial steering in energy are relevant, but the core remains senior FP&A/business partnering rather than treasury or market-risk execution.
The role offers substantive controlling, forecasting and cash-flow analysis, but it is broad operational finance rather than the user's primary treasury, markets or transaction track.
This is meaningful group FP&A and financial steering, but its focus on budgeting, reporting and cost structures is adjacent rather than core target work.
The role is dominated by senior sales, client acquisition, networking and office leadership rather than analytical investment, treasury, risk or transaction execution.
